entities.summary: The University of Novi Sad is a public university in Novi Sad, Serbia. Alongside the University of Belgrade, University of Novi Sad is one of the most important educational and research institutions in Serbia and South Eastern Europe and the flagship institution of higher education in Vojvodina province.
